run_word_alignment_evaluation: run the eval script to evaluate word alignment quality on a test dictionary using source and target embeddings
load_transform_matrix: load a transformation matrix from a text file into a numpy array with configurable dimensions
compute_nn_accuracy: compute nearest-neighbor accuracy between source and target word embeddings using a bilingual lexicon
compute_csls_accuracy: compute CSLS cross-lingual similarity accuracy between source and target embeddings for alignment evaluation
load_and_transform_embeddings: load source and target word embeddings and optionally apply alignment transformation matrices before evaluation
